name: Shifter
description: Slay a foe with the Shifter Perk active (the foe teleports randomly).

name: Bruiser
description: Slay a foe with the Bruiser Perk active (the foe gains greatly increased health and size).

name: Slugger
description: Slay a foe with the Slugger Perk active (the foe deals more damage).

name: Puller
description: Slay a foe with the Puller Perk active (the foe pulls you toward it with a field you must dash to escape).

name: Savior
description: Slay a foe with the Savior Perk active (the foe periodically shields nearby foes).

name: Speeder
description: Slay a foe with the Speeder Perk active (the foe attacks and moves faster).

name: Linker
description: Slay a foe with the Linker Perk active (the foe links to another foe with a damaging laser).

name: Cloner
description: Slay a foe with the Cloner Perk active (the foe spawns fake one-hp clones, Tartarus only).

name: Burner
description: Slay a foe with the Burner Perk active (the foe constantly creates fire traps, Asphodel only).

name: Seeker
description: Slay a foe with the Seeker Perk active (the foe's projectiles home in on you).

name: Popper
description: Slay a foe with the Popper Perk active (the foe drops exploding fake souls alongside the real one, Elysium only).
